quarterly_data.signal: Cummins' 10-K customer concentration: PACCAR is its largest customer, accounting for 13 percent of consolidated net sales in 2025, 16 percent in 2024 and 16 percent in 2023, and is its only customer above 10 percent of net sales in 2025. Cummins has long-term supply agreements with PACCAR for heavy-duty and medium-duty engines and aftertreatment, driveline and brake systems, which set engine requirements for specific vehicle models rather than a specific volume.
